items.title: What Could Meta Platforms (META) Off Balance Sheet AI Financing Mean For Investors?
items.summary: Meta Platforms (NasdaqGS:META) is expanding the use of off-balance-sheet credit backstops to finance AI data centers through residual value guarantees, according to a new report. These structures keep certain liabilities off Meta's balance sheet while potentially exposing the company to future obligations if leveraged data center assets are exited or become unprofitable.
